content.title: President Trump Addresses Nation on War with Iran
content.text: 00:00:23 YOU VERY MUCH. MY FELLOW AMERICANS, GOOD EVENING. LET ME BEGIN BY CONGRATULATING THE TEAM AT NASA. AND OUR BRAVE ASTRONAUTS ON THE SUCCESSFUL LAUNCH OF ARTEMIS II. IT'S AMAZING. THEY ARE ON 2HE 2AY 2ND GOD BLESS THEM. THESE ARE BRAVE PEOPLE. AND UNBELIEVABLE ASTRONAUTS. AS WE SPEAK THIS EVENING, IT'S BEEN ONE MONTH SINCE THE UNITED STATES MILITARY BEGAN OPERATION EPIC FURY, TARGETING THE WORLD'S NUMBER ONE STATE SPONSOR OF TERROR. IRAN. IN THESE PAST FOUR WEEKS, OUR ARMED FORCES HAVE DELIVERED SWIFT, DECISIVE, OVERWHELMING VICTORIES ON THE BATTLE FIELD. VICTORIES LIKE FEW PEOPLE HAVE EVER SEEN BEFORE. TONIGHT IRAN'S NAVY IS GONE. AS IT HAS BEEN FOR FIVE YEARS UNDER MY PRESIDENCY IS WINNING AND NOW WINNING BIGGER THAN EVER BEFORE. BEFORE DISCUSSING THIS CURRENT SITUATION, I ALSO WANT TO THANK OUR TROOPS FOR THE JOB THEY DID IN TAKING THE COUNTRY OF VENEZUELA IN A MATTER OF MINUTES. THAT HIT WAS QUICK, LETHAL, VIOLENT AND RESPECTED BY EVERYONE ALL OVER THE WORLD. AFTER REBUILDING OUR MILITARY DURING MY FIRST TERM, WE HAD, BY FAR, THE STRONGEST MILITARY ANYWHERE IN THE WORLD AND NOW WE'RE WORKING ALONG WITH VENEZUELA AND, IN A TRUE SENSE, JOINT VENTURE PARTNERS. WE'RE GETTING ALONG INCREDIBLY WELL IN THE SALE OF MASSIVE AMOUNTS OF OIL AND GASES, THE SECOND LARGEST RESERVES ON EARTH AFTER THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA. WE'RE NOW TOTALLY INDEPENDENT OF THE MIDDLE EAST AND YET WE ARE THERE TO HELP. WE DON'T HAVE TO BE THERE. WE DON'T NEED THEIR OIL. WE DON'T NEED ANYTHING THEY HAVE BUT WE'RE THERE TO HELP OUR ALLIES. TONIGHT I WANT TO PROVIDE AN UPDATE ON THE TREMENDOUS PROGRESS OUR WARRIORS HAVE MADE IN IRAN AND DISCUSS WHY OPERATION EPIC FURY IS NECESSARY FOR THE SAFETY OF AMERICA AND THE SECURITY OF THE FREE WORLD. FROM THE VERY FIRST DAY I ANNOUNCED MY CAMPAIGN FOR PRESIDENT IN 2015, I HAVE VOWED THAT I WOULD NEVER ALLOW IRAN TO HAVE A NUCLEAR WEAPON. THIS REGIME HAS BEEN CHANTING "DEATH TO AMERICA", "DEATH TO ISRAEL" FOR 47 YEARS. THEIR PROXIES WERE BEHIND THE MURDER OF 241 AMERICANS IN THE MARINE BARRACKS, BOMBING IN BEIRUT. THE SLAUGHTER OF HUNDREDS OF OUR SERVICE MEMBERS WITH ROAD-SIDE BOMBS. THEY WERE INVOLVED IN THE ATTACK ON THE U.S.S. COLE AND CARRIED OUT COUNTLESS OTHER HEINOUS ACTS, INCLUDING THE JUST HORRIBLE, BLOODY ATROCITIES OF OCTOBER 7th IN ISRAEL. SOMETHING THAT MOST PEOPLE NEVER SEEN ANYTHING LIKE IT. THIS MURDEROUS REGIME ALSO RECENTLY KILLED 45,000 OF THEIR OWN PEOPLE, WHO WERE PROTESTING IN IRAN. 45,000 DEAD. FOR THESE TERRORISTS WHO HAVE NUCLEAR WEAPONS, WOULD BE AN INTOLERABLE THREAT. THE MOST VIOLENT AND THUGGISH REGIME ON EARTH WOULD BE FREE TO CARRY OUT THEIR CAMPAIGNS OF TERROR, COERCION, CONQUEST AND MASS MURDER FROM BEHIND A NUCLEAR SHIELD. I WILL NEVER LET THAT HAPPEN AND NEITHER SHOULD ANY OF OUR PAST PRESIDENTS. THE SITUATION HAS BEEN GOING ON FOR 47 YEARS. AND SHOULD HAVE BEEN HANDLED LONG BEFORE I ARRIVED IN OFFICE. I 2ID 2ANY 2HINGS 2URING MY TWO TERMS IN OFFICE TO STOP THE QUEST FOR NUCLEAR WEAPONS BY IRAN FIRST AND PERHAPS MOST IMPORTANTLY I KILLED GENERAL SOL MEANIE IN MY FIRST TERM. EE WAS AN EVIL GENIUS, BRILLIANT PERSON. A HORRIBLE HUMAN BEING, HOWEVER. THE FATHER OF THE ROAD SIDE BOMB. AND HE LIVED JUST HORRIBLE. WHAT HE DID. AND VERY IMPORTANTLY I TERMINATED BARACK HUSSEIN OBAMA'S NUCLEAR DEAL. HE GAVE THEM $1.7 BILLION IN CASH, GREEN, GREEN CASH, TOOK IT OUT OF BANKS FROM VIRGINIA, D.C. AND MARYLAND, ALL THE CASH THEY HAD. HE FLEW IT BY AIRPLANES IN AN ATTEMPT TO BUY THEIR RESPECT AND LOYALTY BUT IT DIDN'T WORK. HIS IRAN DEAL WOULD HAVE LEAD TO A COLOSSAL ARSENAL OF MASSIVE NUCLEAR WEAPONS FROM IRAN BUT THEY WOULD HAVE HAD THEM YEARS AGO. IT WOULD HAVE BEEN A DIFFERENT WORLD. THERE WOULD HAVE BEEN NO MIDDLE EAST OR ISRAEL RIGHT NOW. IN MY OPINION, HAD I NOT TERMINATED THAT TERRIBLE DEAL. I WAS SO HONORED TO DO IT. I WAS SO PROUD TO DO IT. SO PROUD RIGHT FROM THE BEGINNING. I DID WHAT NO OTHER PRESIDENT WAS WILLING TO DO. I MADE MISTAKES AND I'M CORRECTING THEM. MY FIRST PREFERENCE WAS ALWAYS THE PATH OF DIPLOMACY, YET THE REGIME CONTINUED THEIR RELENTLESS QUEST FOR NUCLEAR WEAPONS AND REJECTED ANY ATTEMPT AT AN AGREEMENT. FOR THIS REASON, IN JUNE, I ORDARD STRIKE ON IRAN'S KEY NUCLEAR FACILITIES, IN OPERATION MIDNIGHT HAMMER. NOBODY'S EVER SEEN ANYTHING LIKE IT. THESE BEAUTIFUL B2 BOMBERS PERFORMED MAGNIFICENTLY. AND THEY STUT REBUILD THEIR NUCLEAR PROGRAM AT A TOTALLY DIFFERENT LOCATION AND MAKING IT CLEAR THEY HAD NO INTENTION OF ABANDONING THEIR PURSUIT OF NUCLEAR WEAPONS. WE JUST LEARNED THAT. WE TOOK THEM OUT. WE TOOK THEM ALL OUT. THAT NO ONE WOULD REALLY DARE STOP THEM AND THEIR RACE FOR A NUCLEAR WEAPON, LIKE NOBODY'S SEEN BEFORE. THEY WERE RIGHT AT THE DOORSTEP. AS I STATED IN MY ANNOUNCEMENT OF "OPERATION EPIC FURY" OUR OBJECT FKS ARE SIMPLE AND CLEAR, WE'RE DISMANTLING THE REGIME'S ABILITY TO PROJECT POWER OUTSIDE OF THEIR BORDERS. THERE'S NEVER BEEN ANYTHING LIKE IT MILITARILY. EVERYONE 2S 2ALKING ABOUT IT AND TONIGHT I'M PLEASED TO SAY THAT THESE CORE STRATEGIC OBJECTIVES ARE NEARING COMPLETION. THIS SHORT-TERM INCREASE HAS BEEN THE RESULT OF IRANIAN REGIME LAUNCHING AGAINST OIL TANKERS IN NEIGHBORING COUNTRIES THAT HAVE NOTHING TO DO WITH THE CONFLICT.
